description: Page host lifecycle (worker/page-lifecycle.mjs). Each request row is one HTTP request to the Page as the owner's Catalog forwards it, with the barrier (sync) succeeding. commitOk and commitFailed are settle attempts through /internal/lifecycle-state: commitOk lists the sequence that finishes the pending commit; commitFailed is the step after that sequence fails at its sync, which emits nothing. boot is a cold start; its record is what the constructor reads from host/document and host/creation. A purgeConfirm on a deleted record carries that record's deletion receipt. Responses are summaries: status, error and code, beforeChange for x-pages-lifecycle-rejected, and for 200 replies which receipt was returned with its state.
